# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A strong opening range break followed by a pullback to VWAP with bullish candle confirmation signals resumption of the morning trend. The edge exists because after an initial breakout, smart money often pulls back to VWAP to re-enter, providing a high-probability long setup that captures continuation momentum.

## Mechanism

If price exceeds the 30‑minute opening range high (ORH), then later retests VWAP within ±0.1% of its value and closes bullish (close > VWAP) with volume > 1.5× the 20‑period average volume, enter long at the close of that bar. Initial stop is placed at the opening range low (ORL). Take profit is set at 1.5× risk or trailed using a chandelier exit (2× ATR) once in profit. Regime filters: VIX < 20, time between 09:45‑11:30 ET, and price above the 20‑period EMA ribbon (bullish ribbon alignment).
